name: cl-paseo
description: Use when dispatching or supervising Paseo agents: attached background subagents, detached workers that survive chat, agent personas, or the brief-report-ping handshake teams use to report back. This plugin is the front door for the Paseo agent family; pick the member below that matches the task and load only that one.

interface.longDescription: Packages the fleet's Paseo agent runbooks: attached background subagent dispatch, detached workers that survive the user's next message with parentage repair, agent personas, and the brief-report-ping handshake worker teams use to report back.
defaultPrompt: Dispatch a background subagent for this task.
Dispatch a detached worker that survives chat.
A worker vanished from the child list — diagnose it.
